name: Saaba Wedding Company
headline: A warm welcome. A memorable celebration.
aboutBody: Saaba Wedding Company brings catering and event arrangements together in Chirayinkeezhu. From colourful welcome drinks and generous buffets to floral stages and attentive service, we help shape the details around your occasion. Tell us about your date, venue and guests, and let’s plan your celebration.

heroSlides.alt: Saaba floral wedding stage with a cream sofa and red carpet
Saaba wedding hall dressed in red with gold chairs and chandeliers

about.alt: Floral seaside ceremony setting with a green sofa
Fresh parotta and biriyani prepared for serving

stories.title: The first sip.
stories.body: Colourful drinks, poured fresh as your guests arrive. A thoughtful start to the conversations and celebrations ahead.
stories.note: Plan welcome drinks with your menu.
stories.alt: Saaba staff pouring colourful welcome drinks into glasses

stories.title: A generous feast.
stories.body: Fresh parotta, fragrant biriyani and a plate worth gathering around. We bring the food and the serving together for your celebration.
stories.note: Choose the dishes your guests will enjoy.
stories.alt: Parotta and biriyani being portioned at a Saaba catering counter

stories.title: Beautifully arranged.
stories.body: A well-presented buffet and a team ready to welcome your guests. From the first helping to the last, the little details matter.
stories.alt: Guests being served at Saaba gold buffet counters

stories.title: Your occasion.
stories.body: Flowers, seating and the setting around you. From an intimate gathering to a wedding by the sea, let’s plan a look that feels right for your day.
stories.note: Explore our stages and event arrangements below.
stories.alt: White floral wedding canopy and green sofa overlooking the sea
